```sql
with scoped_orders as (
    select
        o.order_id,
        case
            when o.business_date between date '2026-08-31' and date '2026-09-06' then 'last_week'
            when o.business_date between date '2026-08-24' and date '2026-08-30' then 'previous_week'
        end as period
    from orders o
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where not o.is_test
      and s.country_code = 'GB'
      and o.business_date between date '2026-08-24' and date '2026-09-06'
),
orders_with_attempts as (
    select
        so.period,
        so.order_id,
        max(case when a.status = 'captured' then 1 else 0 end) as succeeded
    from scoped_orders so
    join payment_attempts a on a.order_id = so.order_id
    where not a.is_test
    group by so.period, so.order_id
),
rates as (
    select
        period,
        cast(sum(succeeded) * 1.0 / count(*) as decimal(38,12)) as rate
    from orders_with_attempts
    group by period
),
comparison as (
    select 'last_week' as key, rate as value from rates where period = 'last_week'
    union all
    select 'previous_week' as key, rate as value from rates where period = 'previous_week'
    union all
    select
        'change_vs_previous_week' as key,
        cast(
            (select rate from rates where period = 'last_week')
            - (select rate from rates where period = 'previous_week')
            as decimal(38,12)
        ) as value
)
select key, value
from comparison
order by
    case key
        when 'last_week' then 1
        when 'previous_week' then 2
        when 'change_vs_previous_week' then 3
    end
```
